```{r}
#Load Data for Table 1. Trial demographics
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)

# Continuous Variables: Convert Follow up period (years) to months
data <- data %>%
  mutate(`Follow up period (years)` = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", `Follow up period (years)`)))

# Continuous variable summary
continuous_summary <- data %>%
  mutate(`Follow up period (months)` = `Follow up period (years)` * 12) %>%
  summarize(
    `Follow up period (months)` = paste0(
      median(`Follow up period (months)`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
      IQR(`Follow up period (months)`, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    ),
    `Number enrolled in trial` = paste0(
      sum(`Number enrolled in trial`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
      median(`Number enrolled in trial`, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    )  # Include sum (median) for Number enrolled
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Characteristic", values_to = "Value")

# Categorical Variables: Update column names and handle missing columns
categorical_columns <- c(
  "Randomized? (y/n)", 
  "Study type", 
  "Control group", 
  "Type of drug control", 
  "Mono or combo therapy in control arm", 
  "Type of drug interventional", 
  "Mono or combo therapy in interventional arm", 
  "Subtype",
  "Blinding practice", 
  "Lines of treatment", 
  "Disease status", 
  "Sponser", 
  "Location of trial", 
  "Primary endpoint of trials"
)

# Filter only columns that exist in `data`
categorical_columns <- categorical_columns[categorical_columns %in% colnames(data)]

# Generate a summary for each categorical column
categorical_summary <- lapply(categorical_columns, function(column) {
  if (!is.null(data[[column]]) && length(unique(data[[column]])) > 0) {
    # Create the summary table
    df <- as.data.frame(table(data[[column]]))
    colnames(df) <- c("Category", "Count")
    df$Percentage <- round((df$Count / sum(df$Count)) * 100, 1)
    df$Characteristic <- column
    df$Value <- paste0(df$Category, ": ", df$Count, " (", df$Percentage, "%)")
    return(df[, c("Characteristic", "Value")])
  } else {
    # Return an empty data frame if the column is missing or empty
    return(data.frame(Characteristic = column, Value = "No data available"))
  }
})

# Combine into a single data frame
categorical_summary_df <- do.call(rbind, categorical_summary)

# Combine Continuous and Categorical Summaries
table_1_df <- bind_rows(continuous_summary, categorical_summary_df)

# Export combined summary to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  "Table 1" = table_1_df
), path = "Table_1_Characteristics.xlsx")

# Display the final table
print(table_1_df)
```

```{r}


#Table 2, withdrawl reasons

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)
library(stats)

# Define relevant column names
withdrawal_columns <- c(
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s)",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent",
  "Number withdrew from control arm",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent"
)

randomization_columns <- c(
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)",
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm"
)

# Clean and convert all relevant columns in a single step
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(withdrawal_columns, randomization_columns)), ~ as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", .))))

# Calculate totals
total_randomized_treatment <- sum(data$`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE)
total_randomized_control <- sum(data$`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE)
total_enrolled <- total_randomized_treatment + total_randomized_control

# Create summary data
summary_data <- data.frame(
  Reason = c(
    "Overall withdrawal",
    "Due to adverse event",
    "Due to progression of disease",
    "Due to patient withdrawal of consent",
    "Discontinuation rate"
  ),
  Treatment_Count = c(
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) -
      (sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE))
  ),
  Control_Count = c(
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) -
      (sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE) +
       sum(data$`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
)

# Add percentages and p-values
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Treatment Count (%)` = paste0(Treatment_Count, " (", round((Treatment_Count / total_randomized_treatment) * 100, 2), "%)"),
    `Control Count (%)` = paste0(Control_Count, " (", round((Control_Count / total_randomized_control) * 100, 2), "%)"),
    `Total Count (%)` = paste0(Treatment_Count + Control_Count, " (", round(((Treatment_Count + Control_Count) / total_enrolled) * 100, 2), "%)"),
    p_value = sapply(1:nrow(summary_data), function(i) {
      treatment_count <- Treatment_Count[i]
      control_count <- Control_Count[i]
      contingency_table <- matrix(c(treatment_count, total_randomized_treatment - treatment_count,
                                    control_count, total_randomized_control - control_count), nrow = 2)
      if (all(contingency_table > 0)) {
        chisq.test(contingency_table)$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      }
    })
  )

# Select final columns and write to Excel
summary_output <- summary_data %>%
  select(Reason, `Total Count (%)`, `Treatment Count (%)`, `Control Count (%)`, p_value)

write_xlsx(summary_output, "Withdrawal_Summary_with_Discontinuation_and_P_Values.xlsx")

# Display final table
summary_output
```

```{r}
#Reasons for attirtion with subgroup analysis by tumor type and dz status

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

# Define the specified columns for conversion
columns_to_convert <- c(
  "Total withdrawl of patient consent w/o clear reasons",
  "Total withdrawl due to TRAE (tx adverse effects",
  "Total withdrew due to progression of dz",
  "Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease",
  "Total investigator initated withdrawl due to no longer meeting study eligibility criteria",
  "Withdrew by sponser due to non-compliance",
  "Withdrew due to death",
  "Unspecified loss to f/u",
  "Total N for other reasonsof withdrawl",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz",
  "Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent",
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease",
  "Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent",
  "Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)"
)

# Convert columns to numeric if they exist in data
columns_to_convert <- columns_to_convert[columns_to_convert %in% colnames(data)]
data[columns_to_convert] <- lapply(data[columns_to_convert], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Function to calculate withdrawal summary with count and percentage
calculate_withdrawal_summary <- function(data) {
  # Total withdrawals and enrolled
  total_withdrawals <- sum(data$`Total withdrawl/discontinuation`, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_enrolled <- sum(data$`Number enrolled in trial`, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Summarize each reason for withdrawal with counts and percentages
  summary_table <- data %>%
    summarize(
      `Total Withdrawl consent` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrawl of patient consent w/o clear reasons`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                         round(sum(`Total withdrawl of patient consent w/o clear reasons`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total withdrawl due to TRAE` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrawl due to TRAE (tx adverse effects`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                 round(sum(`Total withdrawl due to TRAE (tx adverse effects`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total withdrew due to progression of dz` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrew due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                        round(sum(`Total withdrew due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease` = paste0(sum(`Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                     round(sum(`Total withdrawl due to complicating medical disease`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total investigator initiated withdrawl` = paste0(sum(`Total investigator initated withdrawl due to no longer meeting study eligibility criteria`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                       round(sum(`Total investigator initated withdrawl due to no longer meeting study eligibility criteria`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Withdrew by sponsor due to non-compliance` = paste0(sum(`Withdrew by sponser due to non-compliance`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                          round(sum(`Withdrew by sponser due to non-compliance`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Withdrew due to death` = paste0(sum(`Withdrew due to death`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                       round(sum(`Withdrew due to death`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Unspecified loss to follow-up` = paste0(sum(`Unspecified loss to f/u`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                               round(sum(`Unspecified loss to f/u`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Total N for other reasons` = paste0(sum(`Total N for other reasonsof withdrawl`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                           round(sum(`Total N for other reasonsof withdrawl`, na.rm = TRUE) / total_withdrawals * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `Discontinuation Rate` = paste0(total_withdrawals, " (", round((total_withdrawals / total_enrolled) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      
      # Control arm withdrawal percentages with count
      `% withdrew from control arm due to adverse event` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                  round(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                     round(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due to progression of dz`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                             round(sum(`Number withdrew from control arm due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to control arm`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      
      # Interventional arm withdrawal percentages with count
      `% withdrew from interventional arm due to adverse event` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                        round(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to adverse event`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from interventional arm due to progression of dz` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                            round(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due to progression of disease`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `% withdrew from interventional arm due patient withdrawl of consent` = paste0(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
                                                                                     round(sum(`Number withdrew from treatment arm(s) due patient withdrawl of consent`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(`Number randomized (or selected)  to treatment arm(s)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)")
    )
  
  return(summary_table)
}

# Step 1: Perform non-subgroup analysis with discontinuation rate
non_subgroup_summary <- calculate_withdrawal_summary(data)

# Step 2: Subgroup analysis by disease status and tumor type
subgroup_disease_status <- data %>%
    group_by(`Disease status`) %>%
    do(calculate_withdrawal_summary(.)) %>%
    ungroup()

subgroup_tumor_type <- data %>%
    group_by(`Subtype`) %>%
    do(calculate_withdrawal_summary(.)) %>%
    ungroup()

# Export all summaries to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  "Non-subgroup Summary" = non_subgroup_summary,
  "By Disease Status" = subgroup_disease_status,
  "By Tumor Type (Subtype)" = subgroup_tumor_type
), path = "Withdrawal_Summary_with_Discontinuation_Rate.xlsx")


```

```{r}


# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

# Define the specified columns
specified_columns <- c(
  "contact patients lost to f/u", "encouragement", "home nursing", 
  "no mitigation stratigies", "patient education", "protocol amendments", 
  "supportive care", "telemedicine", "Non-specific effort", 
  "Unblinding or cross-over", "Dosing or schedule adjustments", 
  "Continued tx after withdrawl or re-challenge"
)

# Calculate count and percentage for each specified column
summary_table <- data %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(specified_columns), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Reason", values_to = "Count")

# Calculate total count to use for percentage calculation
total_count <- sum(summary_table$Count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add percentage and confidence intervals
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Lower_CI = pmax(0, round(((Count / total_count) - 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1)),
    Upper_CI = pmin(100, round(((Count / total_count) + 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1))
  )

# Combine rows with percentages less than 3% into "Other"
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Reason = ifelse(Percentage < 3, "Other", Reason)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Reason) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Lower_CI = pmax(0, round(((Count / total_count) - 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1)),
    Upper_CI = pmin(100, round(((Count / total_count) + 1.96 * sqrt((Count / total_count) * (1 - (Count / total_count)) / total_count)) * 100, 1))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percentage))

# Export the updated summary table to Excel
write_xlsx(summary_table, "Specified_Columns_Summary_Updated_with_CI.xlsx")

# Plot a bar chart with 95% confidence intervals
# Plot a bar chart with 95% confidence intervals
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Mitigation Practices as Percentage of Total (95% CI)",
    x = "Mitigation Practice",
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"  # Remove legend
  )
```

```{r}


#Data availability after withdrawl
#Need for clear reasons for withdrawl
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)

# Define columns to summarize
columns_to_summarize <- c("Did trial state need for clearly documented reasons for withdrawal", 
                          "Data availability after withdrawl?")

# Calculate counts and percentages for each column
summary_table <- lapply(columns_to_summarize, function(column) {
  # Count each unique value and calculate percentage
  data %>%
    count(!!sym(column)) %>%
    rename(Response = !!sym(column), Count = n) %>%
    mutate(
      Percentage = round((Count / sum(Count)) * 100, 1),
      Lower_CI = pmax(0, round(((Count / sum(Count)) - 1.96 * sqrt((Count / sum(Count)) * (1 - (Count / sum(Count))) / sum(Count))) * 100, 1)),
      Upper_CI = pmin(100, round(((Count / sum(Count)) + 1.96 * sqrt((Count / sum(Count)) * (1 - (Count / sum(Count))) / sum(Count))) * 100, 1))
    ) %>%
    mutate(Variable = column) %>%
    select(Variable, Response, Count, Percentage, Lower_CI, Upper_CI)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()  # Combine results into a single data frame

# Export the summary to an Excel file
write_xlsx(list("Counts_and_Percentages" = summary_table), path = "Counts_and_Percentages_Summary_with_CI.xlsx")

# Add an additional variable for titles at the bottom

  mutate(
    Facet_Title = case_when(
      Variable == "Did trial state need for clearly documented reasons for withdrawal" ~ "Did trial state need for clearly documented reasons?",
      Variable == "Data availability after withdrawl?" ~ "Data availability after withdrawal?"
    )
  )

# Plot a bar chart with error bars
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = Response, y = Percentage, fill = Response)) +
```

```{r}

#Regression mitigation

# Load the data
file_path <- "Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data.xlsx"
Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data <- read_excel(file_path)

library(openxlsx)  # For writing to Excel

fit_gam_and_summarize <- function(outcome_column_name, dataset, output_file = NULL) {
  # Verify if the outcome column exists
  if (!(outcome_column_name %in% colnames(dataset))) {
    stop(paste("The outcome column", outcome_column_name, "is not found in the dataset."))
  }
  
  # Select relevant columns dynamically
  regression_data <- dataset %>%
    select(
      all_of(outcome_column_name),
      Contact_Patients_Lost_To_FU,
      Encouragement,
      No_Mitigation_Stratigies,
      Patient_Education,
      Protocol_Amendments,
      Supportive_Care,
      Non_Specific_Effort,
      Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over,
      Dosing_Or_Schedule_Adjustments,
      Continued_Tx_After_Withdrawl_Or_Re_Challenge
    ) %>%
    drop_na()  # Remove rows with NA
  
  # Fit the GAM model for binary data
  gam_model <- gam(
    formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_column_name, "~ 
                                Contact_Patients_Lost_To_FU + 
                                Encouragement + 
                                No_Mitigation_Stratigies + 
                                Patient_Education + 
                                Protocol_Amendments + 
                                Supportive_Care + 
                                Non_Specific_Effort + 
                                Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over + 
                                Dosing_Or_Schedule_Adjustments + 
                                Continued_Tx_After_Withdrawl_Or_Re_Challenge")),
    data = regression_data,
    family = binomial()
  )
  
  # Summarize the model
  summary_df <- as.data.frame(summary(gam_model)$p.table)
  summary_df <- cbind(term = rownames(summary_df), summary_df)
  rownames(summary_df) <- NULL  # Reset row names
  summary_df <- summary_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))  # Round numeric columns to 3 decimal places
  
  # Export results to Excel if output_file is provided
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    wb <- createWorkbook()
    addWorksheet(wb, "GAM_Summary")
    writeData(wb, "GAM_Summary", summary_df)
    saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Return summary and coefficients
  list(
    summary = summary_df,
    coefficients = data.frame(
      term = names(coef(gam_model)),
      estimate = round(coef(gam_model), 3)  # Round coefficients to 3 decimal places
    )
  )
}

# Re-run the model and export results to Excel
output_file <- "GAM_Model_Summary.xlsx"
results_total <- fit_gam_and_summarize("Total_Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason", Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data, output_file)

# Print success message and preview summary
cat("GAM model summary exported to:", output_file, "\n")
print(results_total$summary)




```

```{r}
#Check general linear regression assumptions for withdrawl

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)

# Define the dataset and specify the predictor and outcome variables
outcome_var <- "Withdrawl rate without clear reason interventional arm"
predictor_vars <- c("Follow up period (years)", "Randomized? (y/n)", "Study type", "Control group", 
                    "Type of drug control", "Mono or combo therapy in control arm", 
                    "Mono or combo therapy in interventional arm", "Type of drug interventional", 
                    "Subtype", "Blinding practice", "Lines of treatment", "Disease status", 
                    "Sponser", "Location of trial", "Single site or multi site", 
                    "Number enrolled in trial", "Treatment related disconintuation rate in interventional arm")

# Convert categorical variables to factors
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Update outcome variable to handle spaces by surrounding it with backticks
outcome_var <- "`Withdrawl rate without clear reason interventional arm`"

# Fit the linear regression model, directly including backticks around the outcome variable
model <- lm(`Withdrawl rate without clear reason interventional arm` ~ 
             `Follow up period (years)` + `Randomized? (y/n)` + `Study type` + `Control group` + 
             `Type of drug control` + `Mono or combo therapy in control arm` + 
             `Mono or combo therapy in interventional arm` + `Type of drug interventional` + 
             `Subtype` + `Blinding practice` + `Lines of treatment` + `Disease status` + 
             `Sponser` + `Location of trial` + `Single site or multi site` + 
             `Number enrolled in trial` + `Treatment related disconintuation rate in interventional arm`, 
           data = data)


# Define the numeric predictors and ensure no aliased predictors are included
numeric_predictor_vars <- predictor_vars[sapply(data[predictor_vars], is.numeric)]

# Include the outcome variable for correlation analysis
numerical_vars <- data %>%
  select(`Withdrawl rate without clear reason interventional arm`, all_of(numeric_predictor_vars))

# Plot the correlation matrix for numerical predictors
ggcorr(numerical_vars, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Correlation Matrix for Numerical Predictors")

# Step 2: Check for Multicollinearity Using VIF
vif_results <- vif(model)  # car::vif
print(vif_results)

# Step 3: Check Residuals for Normality
# Extract residuals from the model
residuals <- residuals(model)

# Histogram of residuals
ggplot(data.frame(residuals), aes(x = residuals)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "blue", color = "white") +
  ggtitle("Histogram of Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

# Q-Q plot for residuals
qqnorm(residuals)
qqline(residuals, col = "red")

# Step 4: Check Homoscedasticity (Constant Variance)
# Plot residuals vs fitted values
ggplot(data.frame(fitted = fitted(model), residuals = residuals), aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  ggtitle("Residuals vs Fitted Values") +
  xlab("Fitted Values") +
  ylab("Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

# Step 5: Check Linearity
# Partial residual plots for numeric predictors
numeric_predictor_vars <- predictor_vars[sapply(data[predictor_vars], is.numeric)]
if (length(numeric_predictor_vars) > 0) {
  library(car)
  crPlots(model, terms = numeric_predictor_vars)
}

# Step 3: Residual Plots
# Residuals vs Fitted values plot to check for homoscedasticity and linearity
ggplot(data = data.frame(Fitted = fitted(model), Residuals = resid(model)), 
       aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", col = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted", x = "Fitted values", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

# Normal Q-Q plot to check for normality of residuals
ggplot(data = data.frame(Residuals = resid(model)), aes(sample = Residuals)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q Plot", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()

# Scale-Location plot to check for homoscedasticity
ggplot(data = data.frame(Fitted = fitted(model), Residuals = sqrt(abs(resid(model)))), 
       aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", col = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Scale-Location Plot", x = "Fitted values", y = "√|Residuals|") +
  theme_minimal()

###Data is non-linear, multi-colinerity and homodescaity is present
```

```{r}
#Regression w/ interaction terms and test/validation sets



# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Rename target column to `outcome` if needed
if ("Total withdrawl rate without clear reason" %in% colnames(data)) {
  data <- data %>%
    rename(outcome = `Total withdrawl rate without clear reason`)
} else if (!"outcome" %in% colnames(data)) {
  stop("The target variable `outcome` or `Total withdrawl rate without clear reason` is not found in the dataset.")
}

# Step 2: Preprocess the dataset
# Handle missing values
if (any(is.na(data$outcome))) {
  cat("Removing rows with missing `outcome` values.\n")
  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(outcome))
}

# Ensure `outcome` is numeric
if (!is.numeric(data$outcome)) {
  cat("Converting `outcome` to numeric.\n")
  data$outcome <- as.numeric(data$outcome)
}

# Check for sufficient data points
if (length(unique(data$outcome)) < 2) {
  stop("The target variable `outcome` must have at least two distinct data points.")
}

# Ensure sufficient dataset size
if (nrow(data) < 10) {
  stop("The dataset does not contain enough rows for partitioning.")
}

# Step 3: Split dataset into training (70%), validation (15%), and test (15%) sets
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(data$outcome, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data[trainIndex, ]
remaining_data <- data[-trainIndex, ]

set.seed(123)
valIndex <- createDataPartition(remaining_data$outcome, p = 0.5, list = FALSE)
validation_data <- remaining_data[valIndex, ]
test_data <- remaining_data[-valIndex, ]

cat("Training set size:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
cat("Validation set size:", nrow(validation_data), "\n")
cat("Test set size:", nrow(test_data), "\n")






# Step 3: Separate predictors and outcome
train_outcome <- train_data$outcome
validation_outcome <- validation_data$outcome
test_outcome <- test_data$outcome

train_data <- train_data %>% select(-outcome)
validation_data <- validation_data %>% select(-outcome)
test_data <- test_data %>% select(-outcome)

# Impute missing values in the training set
library(caret)
preProc <- preProcess(train_data, method = "medianImpute")
train_data_imputed <- predict(preProc, train_data)

# Repeat for validation and test sets
validation_data_imputed <- predict(preProc, validation_data)
test_data_imputed <- predict(preProc, test_data)

# Convert to matrices for glmnet
train_matrix <- as.matrix(train_data_imputed)
validation_matrix <- as.matrix(validation_data_imputed)
test_matrix <- as.matrix(test_data_imputed)





# Step 4: Fit the model on the training set using cross-validation to tune lambda
set.seed(123)
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
    train_matrix, train_outcome,
    alpha = 0,  # Ridge regression
    lambda = 10^seq(10, -2, length = 100),
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = 10
)

# Optimal lambda
best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
cat("Best lambda for ridge regularization:", best_lambda, "\n")

# Final model with best lambda
final_model <- glmnet(
    train_matrix, train_outcome,
    alpha = 0,
    lambda = best_lambda,
    standardize = TRUE
)

# Step 5: Make predictions and evaluate performance on each set

# Training set performance
train_predictions <- predict(final_model, s = best_lambda, newx = train_matrix)
train_rss <- sum((train_outcome - train_predictions)^2)
train_tss <- sum((train_outcome - mean(train_outcome))^2)
train_r_squared <- 1 - train_rss / train_tss
cat("Training R-squared:", train_r_squared, "\n")

# Validation set performance
validation_predictions <- predict(final_model, s = best_lambda, newx = validation_matrix)
validation_rss <- sum((validation_outcome - validation_predictions)^2)
validation_tss <- sum((validation_outcome - mean(validation_outcome))^2)
validation_r_squared <- 1 - validation_rss / validation_tss
cat("Validation R-squared:", validation_r_squared, "\n")

# Test set performance
test_predictions <- predict(final_model, s = best_lambda, newx = test_matrix)
test_rss <- sum((test_outcome - test_predictions)^2)
test_tss <- sum((test_outcome - mean(test_outcome))^2)
test_r_squared <- 1 - test_rss / test_tss
cat("Test R-squared:", test_r_squared, "\n")




# Step 6: Ensure test_predictions is a vector
test_predictions <- as.vector(test_predictions)  # Convert predictions to a vector if necessary

# Now create the data frame and plot
test_results <- data.frame(Observed = test_outcome, Predicted = test_predictions)

# Plot observed vs predicted values for the test set
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted Plot - Test Set",
         x = "Predicted Values",
         y = "Observed Values") +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#removal variables, 1st approach
# Load necessary libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)


# Step 1: Read and Preprocess the Data
data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Sheet1")

# Rename the target column
if ("Total withdrawl rate without clear reason" %in% colnames(data)) {
  data <- data %>% rename(outcome = `Total withdrawl rate without clear reason`)
} else if (!"outcome" %in% colnames(data)) {
  stop("The target variable `outcome` is not found in the dataset.")
}

# Handle missing values and ensure `outcome` is numeric
if (any(is.na(data$outcome))) {
  cat("Removing rows with missing `outcome` values.\n")
  data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(outcome))
}
data$outcome <- as.numeric(data$outcome)

# Ensure sufficient data points and dataset size
if (length(unique(data$outcome)) < 2) {
  stop("The target variable `outcome` must have at least two distinct data points.")
}
if (nrow(data) < 10) {
  stop("The dataset does not contain enough rows for partitioning.")
}

# Step 2: Exclude specified columns (known outcomes)
columns_to_remove <- c(18:37, 40:42)
# Ensure correct dplyr usage
library(dplyr)

# Validate that column indices are within range
if (max(columns_to_remove) > ncol(data)) {
    stop("Indices in columns_to_remove exceed the number of columns in the dataset.")
}

# Get the column names to remove
columns_to_remove_names <- colnames(data)[columns_to_remove]

# Remove the specified columns using dplyr::select
data <- data %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(columns_to_remove_names))
# Step 3: Split dataset into training (80%), validation (10%), and test (10%) sets
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(data$outcome, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data[trainIndex, ]
remaining_data <- data[-trainIndex, ]

set.seed(123)
valIndex <- createDataPartition(remaining_data$outcome, p = 0.5, list = FALSE)
validation_data <- remaining_data[valIndex, ]
test_data <- remaining_data[-valIndex, ]

cat("Training set size:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
cat("Validation set size:", nrow(validation_data), "\n")
cat("Test set size:", nrow(test_data), "\n")

# Separate predictors and outcome
train_outcome <- train_data$outcome
validation_outcome <- validation_data$outcome
test_outcome <- test_data$outcome

# Ensure the use of dplyr namespace explicitly
train_data <- train_data %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of("outcome"))
validation_data <- validation_data %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of("outcome"))
test_data <- test_data %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of("outcome"))

# Ensure 'Follow up period' is numeric

# Ensure 'Follow up period (years)' is numeric in all datasets
train_data$`Follow up period (years)` <- as.numeric(as.character(train_data$`Follow up period (years)`))
validation_data$`Follow up period (years)` <- as.numeric(as.character(validation_data$`Follow up period (years)`))
test_data$`Follow up period (years)` <- as.numeric(as.character(test_data$`Follow up period (years)`))

# Impute missing values with the median if any
if (any(is.na(train_data$`Follow up period (years)`))) {
    train_data$`Follow up period (years)`[is.na(train_data$`Follow up period (years)`)] <- 
        median(train_data$`Follow up period (years)`, na.rm = TRUE)
}
if (any(is.na(validation_data$`Follow up period (years)`))) {
    validation_data$`Follow up period (years)`[is.na(validation_data$`Follow up period (years)`)] <- 
        median(validation_data$`Follow up period (years)`, na.rm = TRUE)
}
if (any(is.na(test_data$`Follow up period (years)`))) {
    test_data$`Follow up period (years)`[is.na(test_data$`Follow up period (years)`)] <- 
        median(test_data$`Follow up period (years)`, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Create dummy variables excluding `Follow up period (years)`
dummy <- dummyVars(" ~ . - `Follow up period (years)`", data = train_data)
train_data_dummy <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = train_data))
validation_data_dummy <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = validation_data))
test_data_dummy <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = test_data))

# Add `Follow up period (years)` back to the datasets as a numeric column
train_data_numeric <- cbind(train_data_dummy, `Follow up period (years)` = train_data$`Follow up period (years)`)
validation_data_numeric <- cbind(validation_data_dummy, `Follow up period (years)` = validation_data$`Follow up period (years)`)
test_data_numeric <- cbind(test_data_dummy, `Follow up period (years)` = test_data$`Follow up period (years)`)

# Verify `Follow up period (years)` is numeric
if (!is.numeric(train_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)`)) {
    train_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)` <- as.numeric(as.character(train_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)`))
}
if (!is.numeric(validation_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)`)) {
    validation_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)` <- as.numeric(as.character(validation_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)`))
}
if (!is.numeric(test_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)`)) {
    test_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)` <- as.numeric(as.character(test_data_numeric$`Follow up period (years)`))
}

# Final checks to ensure consistency before converting to matrices
str(train_data_numeric)
str(validation_data_numeric)
str(test_data_numeric)

# Convert to matrices for glmnet
train_matrix <- as.matrix(train_data_numeric)
validation_matrix <- as.matrix(validation_data_numeric)
test_matrix <- as.matrix(test_data_numeric)

# Verify no missing values
cat("Missing values in train_matrix:", sum(is.na(train_matrix)), "\n")
cat("Missing values in validation_matrix:", sum(is.na(validation_matrix)), "\n")
cat("Missing values in test_matrix:", sum(is.na(test_matrix)), "\n")

# Ensure all matrices are numeric
if (any(!is.numeric(train_matrix))) stop("Train matrix contains non-numeric values.")
if (any(!is.numeric(validation_matrix))) stop("Validation matrix contains non-numeric values.")
if (any(!is.numeric(test_matrix))) stop("Test matrix contains non-numeric values.")

# Step 1: Impute missing values in train, validation, and test datasets
impute_missing <- function(data_frame) {
  for (col in colnames(data_frame)) {
    if (is.numeric(data_frame[[col]])) {
      if (any(is.na(data_frame[[col]]))) {
        # Impute missing values with median
        data_frame[[col]][is.na(data_frame[[col]])] <- median(data_frame[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    } else {
      # Handle non-numeric columns if necessary
      warning(paste("Column", col, "is not numeric and will be skipped for imputation."))
    }
  }
  return(data_frame)
}

# Apply imputation to train, validation, and test datasets
train_data_numeric <- impute_missing(train_data_numeric)
validation_data_numeric <- impute_missing(validation_data_numeric)
test_data_numeric <- impute_missing(test_data_numeric)

# Step 2: Convert to matrices for glmnet
train_matrix <- as.matrix(train_data_numeric)
validation_matrix <- as.matrix(validation_data_numeric)
test_matrix <- as.matrix(test_data_numeric)

# Step 3: Verify no missing values remain
cat("Missing values in train_matrix:", sum(is.na(train_matrix)), "\n")
cat("Missing values in validation_matrix:", sum(is.na(validation_matrix)), "\n")
cat("Missing values in test_matrix:", sum(is.na(test_matrix)), "\n")

# Step 4: Ensure all matrices are numeric
if (any(!is.numeric(train_matrix))) stop("Train matrix contains non-numeric values.")
if (any(!is.numeric(validation_matrix))) stop("Validation matrix contains non-numeric values.")
if (any(!is.numeric(test_matrix))) stop("Test matrix contains non-numeric values.")

# Step 5: Fit Ridge regression model with cross-validation
set.seed(123)
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
  train_matrix, train_outcome,
  alpha = 0,  # Ridge regression
  lambda = 10^seq(10, -2, length = 100),
  standardize = TRUE,
  nfolds = 10
)




# Optimal lambda
best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
cat("Best lambda for ridge regularization:", best_lambda, "\n")

# Final Ridge regression model
ridge_model <- glmnet(
  train_matrix, train_outcome,
  alpha = 0,
  lambda = best_lambda,
  standardize = TRUE
)

# Step 8: Compute R-Squared for Training, Validation, and Test Sets
compute_r_squared <- function(predictions, actuals) {
  rss <- sum((actuals - predictions)^2)
  tss <- sum((actuals - mean(actuals))^2)
  return(1 - rss / tss)
}

train_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = best_lambda, newx = train_matrix)
validation_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = best_lambda, newx = validation_matrix)
test_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = best_lambda, newx = test_matrix)

train_r_squared <- compute_r_squared(train_predictions, train_outcome)
validation_r_squared <- compute_r_squared(validation_predictions, validation_outcome)
test_r_squared <- compute_r_squared(test_predictions, test_outcome)

cat("Training R-squared:", train_r_squared, "\n")
cat("Validation R-squared:", validation_r_squared, "\n")
cat("Test R-squared:", test_r_squared, "\n")
```
